observations: body L1-L5: the end of the commentary on chapter 57 c) begun on p. 321. «Albatenium», «Ptolemaeum», «Wolf» and «Regiomontanus» (L3) are letter-spaced; «Regiomontanum» (L4) is not. The hyphen of «inscri-» measures 2.3 pt. A speck stands under the first e of «referri» and another after «libro» (L5).
body L6-L7: the head is set in capitals and small capitals, as the heads of the chapters; the dash after «a)» measures 10.1 pt. The place is p. 145 of the translation, where appendix A begins.

body L8-L28: «A–H» has a long dash (5.3 pt), as have «7–8» and «187–88» (5.4 pt each); «10-11» (L21) has a hyphen (3.1 pt); «al–Battānī» (L26) is letter-spaced, with a long dash (5.4 pt). The ordinals 1° to 5° are set as printed, with a raised small o. The tables of vol. II, pp. 7-8 are those of the beginnings of the Arab years and months and of the signs of the Roman months; those of pp. 187-188 serve the revolutions of the years. The words quoted in 4° are p. 129, L10-L11 of the translation. In 5°, p. 94, L10-L11 of the translation read «eo modo inveneris ut in illo capite prope illas tabulas docuimus», where L23 quotes «quem in illo capite». Nallino's addenda (Part I, p. LXXIX, «322, in fine adn. a»): the Spanish version, which also lacks these appendices, has on f. 63 v., between the tables of the parallax of the Moon in the climes and the tables of the mean motions of the planets, a «Capitulo de saber quando es la planeta endereçada y quando es estacionaria y quando es retrograda», probably the spurious appendix D of the Arabic codex.

body L29-L33: the dash after «b)» measures 9.6 pt, the dash after «I.» 10.1 pt; «al–Battānī» (L30) is letter-spaced, with a long dash (4.4 pt). The place is p. 145, L8 of the translation, as printed: the count of that page runs through the head and the space under the title, so that L8 is «Dicit [auctor]: Signum anni aerae Arabicae». The rule of L30-L31 is p. 145, L16-L17 («numero reperto sub annis [ab hegira] collectis semper unum adde»). L33 is right: a common year of 354 days is 50 weeks and 4 days. The hyphens of «singulo-» and «an-» measure 2.3 and 2.6 pt.

notes_left L1-L8: «Monteregio» and «Purbachii» are letter-spaced; the hyphen of «Al-» (L3) prints as a raised dot. No full stop stands after the closing parenthesis of note 1 (L6). «4-5» (L7) has a hyphen (3.4 pt). The place corrected by note 2 is p. 71, L4-L5 of the translation; Nallino's addenda (Part I, p. LXXI: «71,4–5, emendetur iuxta quae dixi p. 322, adn. 2.») refer to this note, and the record of p. 71 notes it.
notes_right L1-L8: note 2 runs on into the right column. The title of appendix C quoted in note 3 is p. 146 of the translation («Caput de inveniendis per has tabulas aeris Arabum et Romanorum»).

review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
